info.name: Merchant Discovery Super-App API (Workflow-Arranged for Frontend)
info.description: Organized workflow-first Postman collection for frontend developers building the Customer App, Merchant Dashboard, and Admin Back-Office Portal. Pointed to Live Render backend (https://pinak-server-6.onrender.com).

item.name: 📱 1. Customer App Workflow
item.description: End-to-end customer mobile and web journey: Public store discovery, GPS nearby search, customer authentication, profile, voucher redemption, payments, wallet rewards, and notifications.

item.name: 1.1 Public Discovery & Store Search
item.description: Public unauthenticated APIs for landing page, home screen, category browsing, and GPS store discovery.

1.2 Customer Authentication & Sessions
item.description: Customer registration, OTP verification, password login, token refresh, and session logout.

request.description: Sends numeric OTP to phone number. In dev/mock mode, check application terminal/logs for the printed OTP.

exec: console.log("✅ Phone OTP login tokens auto-saved");

console.log("✅ Customer accessToken auto-saved to collection variable");

request.description: Requests password reset OTP. In dev/mock mode, OTP is logged and printed in response message.
Verifies OTP and returns temporary reset token ID.
Sets a new strong password using verified reset token, invalidating all existing sessions.

item.name: 1.3 Customer Profile & Security
item.description: Authenticated customer profile management, active device sessions, and session revocation.

request.description: Change password for currently authenticated user. Requires currentPassword and strong newPassword meeting policy rules. On success, active sessions are invalidated to enforce re-login.

item.name: 1.4 Offer Redemption & Checkout
item.description: Claiming discounts, initiating UPI/gateway payment intents, mock webhooks, and redemption confirmation.

request.description: Initiates payment for an eligible offer/store with mandatory Idempotency-Key. Backend calculates discount, payable amount, and returns provider intent.
Fetch status and details of an existing payment by ID.
Cancel an INITIATED or PENDING payment.
Public provider webhook ingestion with signature verification, replay protection, and status transition.

item.description: Customer reward points balance, points audit ledger, and payment transaction receipts.

item.description: In-app notification feed, unread counters, mark as read, and user notification channel preferences.
